# Item

A row with media, a title, a description and actions.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Content first</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Content first:** Rows in the reading list, each with an action named in a word. Not where cards preview articles.

- **Use it when:** Lists of things such as people, files or settings, each with a few actions.
- **Not when:** Records people compare cell by cell (a table).

Instead:

- [Card](./card.md): A larger unit with more content.
- [Table](./table.md): Records compared across columns.

## Why it works this way

Item looks the way it does because of 5 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Item, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-elevation-definition"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What separates groups on the page?</b><code>elevation.definition</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Space</div><p>Space separates groups; lines would interrupt reading.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Item</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: Rows in the reading list, separated by space, not lines.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>outline</b>: Borders would interrupt reading; space separates the rows.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Item decisions would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-spacing-values"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How dense is the layout?</b><code>spacing.values</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Spacious</div><p>Room around the text helps reading.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Item</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: Rows in the reading list, separated by space, not lines.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Item decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-human-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What must the interface protect?</b><code>human.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Attention on the content</div><p>Attention belongs to the text.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Item</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>muted</b>: Every row in the reading list weighs the same; attention belongs to the text.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: large</code> <code>Field: horizontal</code> <code>Empty: default</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Item decision would reopen</small><p>and 8 answers that follow from it: <b>Surface, text, action and status</b>, <b>Only what floats</b>, <b>One</b>, and 5 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-accessibility-values"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the smallest target?</b><code>accessibility.values</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Touch size</div><p>Readers are often on phones.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Item</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: Every row, at touch size: many readers are on phones.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>sm</b>: Many readers are on phones, and rows are read, not scanned.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: default</code> <code>Button: compact</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Item decisions would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>Those and pressed</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-tasks-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main task?</b><code>tasks.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Read start to end</div><p>People read from start to end.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Item</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>sm</b>: Many readers are on phones, and rows are read, not scanned.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">4</div><small>Item decisions would reopen</small><p>and 23 answers that follow from it: <b>Rarely</b>, <b>Attention on the content</b>, <b>Reading comfort</b>, and 20 more.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.
